en.p: A cubic function $f(x)$ with leading coefficient $1$ satisfies the following condition.

box: For the function $f(x)$, there is **no** integer $k$ satisfying $f(k-1)f(k+1)<0$.

en.p: When $f'\!\left(-\dfrac{1}{4}\right)=-\dfrac{1}{4}$ and $f'\!\left(\dfrac{1}{4}\right)<0$, find the value of $f(8)$. [4 points]
